feature: AI chatbot, link previews & AI enhancements
summary: Since Firefox 148 there is a dedicated AI Controls section with a single "Block AI enhancements" switch. For a scorched-earth version, flip the browser.ml prefs in about:config.

steps.path: about:config → set browser.ml.enabled to false. Community reports say the sub-prefs are worth setting too:
steps.code:
browser.ml.enabled = false
browser.ml.chat.enabled = false
browser.ml.linkPreview.enabled = false
browser.ml.pageAssist.enabled = false
browser.ml.smartAssist.enabled = false
browser.urlbar.quicksuggest.mlEnabled = false
browser.tabs.groups.smart.enabled = false

collateral: local translation and smart tab grouping go away with the scorched-earth prefs
whyTheyDidIt: Mozilla shipped AI features but kept a real off switch — this is what the baseline should look like everywhere.

sources.label: Kaspersky — Firefox AI Controls and browser.ml prefs
